description: Sans-IO time and reservation protocols: avb-gptp (slave-only 802.1AS end station: messages, peer delay initiator+responder, asCapable, port SM, PI servo, step bookkeeping, gPTP<->mach model, status; design §7) and avb-srp (802.1Q MRP applicant/registrar/LeaveAll, PDU vector codec, MSRP attributes incl. TA_WAIT support, MVRP; §8). Depends on FEAT-002 (avb-core). avb-gptp and avb-srp are independent of each other.
steps: Create crates/avb-gptp (lib avb_gptp; deps avb-core path, serde =1.0.229 derive; #![deny(clippy::indexing_slicing)]): msg (encode/decode Sync two-step Rx, Follow_Up + 802.1AS FU info TLV, Pdelay_Req/Resp/Resp_Follow_Up Tx+Rx, Announce + path trace, Signaling with message-interval-request and gPTP-capable TLV; header majorSdoId 1, version 2, domain 0; validation per §13.2), LatencyProfile::I210_1000 (tx +178 ns, rx -448 ns), clockIdentity from MAC (EUI-64), port number 1.

avb-gptp pdelay: initiator every 1 s with want_ts (deferred <=50 ms behind an in-flight response), t1..t4 matching, NRR window (k<=8, current generation only, cleared on gen change, held NRR until 2 new exchanges, |NRR-1|>1000 ppm rejected -> nrr_out_of_range), delay raw + compensated; responder (Pdelay_Resp want_ts, Follow_Up with t3_c; skip FU across a step -> pdelay_resp_step_skip; late-drop when mach_now - harvest_mach > 8 ms -> pdelay_resp_late_drop; TS timeout -> pdelay_resp_ts_fail); asCapable (delay<=800 ns, lost<=3, no multi-responder in last 3, NRR valid, gPTP-capable TLV receipt timeout).

avb-gptp port + servo + stepgen (§7.3): port Listening/Slave with Announce acceptance rules, Ta from logMessageInterval [-3,4] else kept (announce_interval_invalid), announceReceiptTimeout 3*Ta, asCapable-loss edge, last_gm handling, ADP re-advertise action emitted on Slave/GM change/Listening; Sync acceptance from master port with Follow_Up within 3*Ts, Ts from logMessageInterval [-5,1] else kept (sync_interval_invalid), gains recomputed on Ts change (Kp 0.2/Ts, Ki 0.02/Ts); offset formula with both correction fields (2^-16); servo states ACQUIRE/TRACKING/LOCKED/HOLDOVER exactly per the §7.3 table incl. step rule (>100 us StepClock, >1 s SetClock), clamp 488000 ppb with anti-windup, LOCKED after 16 <1 us, unlock after 4 >10 us; stepgen classify_rx_gen(slot_gen, ambig) and the TX-generation hold (no step while want_ts outstanding; no new want_ts while a step is pending). Port has a role field but NO Announce/Sync/Follow_Up TX path. Our Signaling gPTP-capable reply only if received (§7.4); message-interval-request honored in [-3,3].

avb-gptp model (§7.5: ReadClock(8) min-bracket sample every 125 ms, LSQ over 64 samples with rebased epoch, outlier rejection > 2x median bracket, GptpMachModel{epoch_mach, epoch_gptp, slope, valid, uncertainty_ns} implementing avb_core::SeqWords, reset on step/GM change) and status (§7.6 GptpStatus serde with every listed counter incl. rev-4/rev-5 counters, nrr_systim and nrr_free).

avb-gptp tests (§14.1 avb-gptp row, every item): byte-exact vectors per message type (from 802.1AS figures; M1 captures added later), Phase 0b delay vector raw 455.6 -> comp 142.6, servo simulation at Ts in {1/32, 1/8, 1} s with -83 ppm GM and 10 ns RMS noise (lock within 10 s / 30 s at 1 s; |mean|<5 ns, sd<20 ns) plus mid-run Ts change without unlock, 600 ppm step-input anti-windup test, Ts/Ta rejection cases (-6, 2, 0x7F; 5, 0x7F), every port-SM edge, every step-bookkeeping case incl. the FakeDext-style simulated 5 ms delayed tick, NRR across a 100 us step (<=0.01 ppm change, asCapable stays true), ACQUIRE SetClock hold, 1.5e-3 NRR rejection, non-zero Sync correctionField vector, 8 ms vs 7.9 ms late-drop, model regression with outliers.

Create crates/avb-srp (lib avb_srp; deps avb-core, serde; #![deny(clippy::indexing_slicing)]): mrp (applicant VO..LO incl. point-to-point, registrar IN/LV/MT, LeaveAll with randomized 10-15 s using an injected RNG seed, JoinTime 200 ms, LeaveTime 1000 ms, periodic timer disabled; hand-written tables from 802.1Q-2018 §10.7 with citations), PDU vector codec (ProtocolVersion 0, VectorHeader LeaveAll+NumberOfValues, ThreePacked + FourPacked, encode NumberOfValues=1, decode >1 with FirstValue+n increments, EndMark required, AttributeLength checks, <=512 values), msrp (Talker Advertise/Failed registrar with stored fields + first/last seen, Listener applicant Ready/Asking Failed, Domain applicant+registrar default {6,3,2} with adoption -> domain_mismatch, TalkerChanged event, A5_FAILURE_CODES const list with citations), mvrp (VID attribute type 1 len 2 per distinct VID), participant (declare(Attribute) generic incl. TalkerAdvertise for talker-readiness, withdraw_all, MSRP event log serde). Before finishing, check 802.1Q-2018 §35.2.4.3/§35.2.6 for Listener-without-Talker: if forbidden, do NOT implement the TA_WAIT Asking-Failed declaration and send_message severity 'warning' to the user (design §4).

avb-srp tests: every applicant/registrar transition row, LeaveAll, encode/decode vectors for Domain, TA, TF, Listener (four-packed) and MVRP VID, NumberOfValues > 1 decode, Domain adoption, TalkerChanged emission.

Add both crates to workspace members; update Cargo.lock offline. Append FEAT-003 to /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/.agents/tasks/phase1a-impl-verification.md (include the servo simulation numbers and the 802.1Q §35.2.4.3/§35.2.6 finding); commit 'feat(gptp,srp): slave-only gPTP stack and MRP/MSRP/MVRP (phase1a FEAT-003)'.
acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p avb-gptp -p avb-srp --locked passes, including the servo simulation pass criteria at all three Ts values and the mid-run Ts change
avb-gptp contains no code path that encodes Announce, Sync or Follow_Up for transmission
No crate in this FEAT reads clocks, spawns threads or does I/O (time and frames injected)
clippy -D warnings clean with clippy::indexing_slicing denied in both crates
